description: Implementation of CyclicBuffer class managing a circular buffer with synchronization, locking, and reservation features, used for inter-process communication or data streaming in the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class implementing a thread-safe, shared memory circular buffer with locking, reservation, and notification mechanisms for inter-process communication.

methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with filename, mode, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with a DataElementFile, offset, size, and overwrite flag.
